definitions.gloss: defensive capability; defense strength; military defense power
definitions.explanation: The ability of a nation, organization, or entity to defend itself. Most commonly used in discussions of national security and military policy.

examples.japanese: {防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}の{強化|きょうか}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{日本|にほん}は{防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}を{増強|ぞうきょう}する{方針|ほうしん}を{示|しめ}した。
examples.english: Japan indicated a policy of bolstering its defense capabilities.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{情勢|じょうせい}が{不安定|ふあんてい}になる{中|なか}で、{各国|かっこく}が{防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}の{見直|みなお}しを{進|すす}めている。
examples.english: As the international situation becomes unstable, countries are advancing reviews of their defense capabilities.

notes:
Composed of {防衛|ぼうえい} (defense, national defense) + {力|りょく} (power, capability). A key term in Japanese political and news vocabulary, appearing frequently in discussions about the Self-Defense Forces ({自衛隊|じえいたい}), defense budgets, and security policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}の{強化|きょうか}: strengthening defense capabilities
- {防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}を{増強|ぞうきょう}する: to bolster defense capabilities
- {防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}の{整備|せいび}: development of defense capabilities
- {防衛力|ぼうえいりょく}の{見直|みなお}し: review of defense capabilities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {軍事力|ぐんじりょく}: military power — broader, includes offensive capacity; used for countries with full militaries
- {戦力|せんりょく}: war potential, fighting strength — the capacity to wage war; constitutionally sensitive term in Japan
- {抑止力|よくしりょく}: deterrence — the power to prevent attack by threatening retaliation
